## Why visit

A purposeful suburban choice for drinkers who want to compare several Manchester-area breweries in one place. The bar’s emphasis is local cask and community rather than architectural spectacle, so it is most useful when a Stretford or tram-based outing already makes sense. It offers a different angle on the regional beer scene from visiting one brewery’s own taproom. Pair the stop with another planned activity or neighbourhood visit; it does not need to displace a first visit to Marble Arch or the core heritage pubs.

## Beer

CAMRA documents five cask lines, including a Marble-brewed house beer, with guests such as Brightside, RedWillow and Runaway.
